steps.name: preflight
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "f6f316308520cff744b8a02545a5dedb09b27dbc"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts >/dev/null

steps.name: direct-vulnerabilities
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm audit --json >/tmp/matrixhub-audit-v2.json || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/matrixhub-audit-v2.json'))
print('SUMMARY', json.dumps(d['metadata']['vulnerabilities'], sort_keys=True))
for name,v in sorted(d.get('vulnerabilities',{}).items()):
    if v.get('isDirect'):
        print('DIRECT', json.dumps({'name':name,'severity':v.get('severity'),'range':v.get('range'),'fixAvailable':v.get('fixAvailable'),'effects':v.get('effects')}, sort_keys=True))
print('ALL_NAMES', ' '.join(sorted(d.get('vulnerabilities',{}))))
PY

steps.name: outdated
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm outdated --json >/tmp/matrixhub-outdated-v2.json || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/matrixhub-outdated-v2.json'))
for name,v in sorted(d.items()): print('OUTDATED', json.dumps({'name':name,'current':v.get('current'),'wanted':v.get('wanted'),'latest':v.get('latest'),'type':v.get('type')}, sort_keys=True))
PY

steps.name: dependency-paths
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; for p in vitest @vitest/ui @vitest/coverage-v8 @inlang/paraglide-js @sveltejs/kit svelte basic-ftp minimatch @isaacs/brace-expansion devalue; do echo ===$p===; npm explain "$p" 2>/dev/null | head -80 || true; done
